description: This file sets up the command-line interface for the Rock Paper Scissors game, utilizing the Cobra library to define the root command and subcommands. It orchestrates the game execution by invoking the PlayGame function from the internal/rockpaperscissors package and handles CLI flags such as 'secretMode'.

methods.name: init
methods.description: Initializes the command-line interface by adding the 'rockpaperscissors' command with the 'secretMode' flag to the root command.
